category.name: zoo.advisor.descriptions
category.item: Great! No one can really complain about the lack in variety of species in your zoo. Keep it up!

Visitors like it when they can admire a large variety of animals in a zoo. You have %currentspecies% of different species, that's a lot! Check out the shop, you'll find at least %missingspecies% more in there.
Zoogoers want to see as many animals as possible. But your zoo is worth it. You currently own %currentspecies% of animals. You can find at least %missingspecies% more species in the pet shop.

Anyone who goes to the zoo wants to see the animals! Your zoo vould have an even wider variety: Currently, you have %currentspecies% animal species. The Zoo-shop offers at least %missingspecies% more.

Oh! There aren't many species of animals in your zoo. Visitors can admire %currentspecies% species, which they can manage fairly quickly. Quickly buy at least %missingspecies% more animals in the Zoo Shop.
Your animals are completely satisfied. You are an exemplary zoo director.
You are taking great care of your animals, but look, some of them deserve even more attention.
Oh! Your animals are a little bored. Wouldn't you like to play with them a little, feed them or give them water? That would be great for them and they would be really happy again!
Oh my! Your animals are sad because you haven't been taking care of them. Play with them a little! Some food and water will also cheer them up. Then your zoo will shine again and delight visitors!
Oh no! Your animals are hungry and thirsty! Come on, take care of them! Once they are fed and the enclosures are cleaned, it will be fun to play with the animals again!
Wow! Your zoo is beautifully decorated! There's so much for visitors to see. Keep it up!
Great! You've decorated your zoo nicely! Check out the zoo shop: you'll find lots of other nice and funny decorations there. Your visitors love a change!
Your zoo is nice, but it could use a little more change! You can find lots of nice and funny decorations in the zoo shop.
Practical and functional, but a little boring. The visitors would appreciate more decorations. Let everyone see that you have more to show!
Your zoo could be a little more decorated. Please your visitors with new striking decorations.
So many adorable babies! You really have golden hands and so your animals have lots of offspring. Great!
The headlines about babies in the zoo draw visitors in. However, every Zoo director always finds a way to improve. Look: Currently, you can breed %missingbabies% more babies.
News of the zoo's new additions are spreading far and wide. Visitors love the little clumsy cubs! Currently, you can raise %missingbabies% more cubs.
Your zoo could use more offspring. Look: %missingbabies% pairs are wishing for a baby. Try breeding!
There's a concern for offspring in your zoo: %missingbabies% pairs are wishing for a baby. Try breeding and charm the visitors with the sight of clumsy babies.
Perfect, your zoo is squeaky clean! The visitors like that. Keep it up!
You're doing great, but your zoo would be even nicer if you cleaned the rest of the trash.
The trash in your zoo is slowly piling up. At last, clean it up.
There's a lot of trash lying around in your zoo. You should definitely tidy up and clean everything.
Your zoo is drowning in trash! Clean the mountains of trash from the paths and empty the trash cans.

category.name: zoo.advisor.help
category.item: In the "Animal Species" category, you can see whether all possible animal species are present in your zoo.
The "Satisfaction" category shows how satisfied your animals currently are.
In the "Decorations" category you'll see whether the decorations in your zoo are attractive for visitors.
Visitors love cute babies! The "Animal Breeding" item will show you the level of success of your breeding.
The "Trash" item will show you if your zoo is clean or if visitors are tripping over mountains of trash.
Use keys 1 to 7 to get to the store faster.
Use the keys Q, W, E and R to: move (W), flip (E), sell (R) or change game mode (Q).
Remember to use a secure password that you don't share with anyone!
You can turn game tips and various other features such as visitors, background effects, and sound effects on or off to make the game run faster on weaker computers.
Buy Zoo Dollars at the bank. You can sometimes get them as a reward for completing daily tasks. You can also get them by level up enough.
Every now and then there will be promotions with bonus codes. Keep an eye on the official forum announcements.
Your animals can get sick. The better you care for them, the longer they will stay healthy. But if your animal isn't sick, you can't even give it the injection.
Your animals feel great in all habitats. And it doesn't matter which habitat you place them in.
Currently you can't move any animal to a different habitat.
If you sell a habitat, you also sell the animal living in it.

There are two types of meerkats in the game - normal and the gray meerkat Bill. Bill only appears during certain events and can only be purchased on special days. note: the gray meerkats name in english is bill
If you click on "adopt for zoodollar", there is a 100% chance of new offspring and you dont have to wait for it.
You can add your Zoomumba friends to your address book. Sadly, you can't invite any neighbors right now.
The more shops you own, the more petpennies you earn.
Don't have time? Hire some assistants. Don't forget that the assistants work only if you click on them (they dont work automatically).
If you hire a cashier, Kešík, you will increase your income.
Using assistants is worth it: you will gain more experience points.
If you have all six assistants on staff, Dave the Co-Director will be available! Click on Dave to get all of your assistants to start working simultaneously.
The more waste you sort at the zoo, the less of it will end up on the streets.
Buy a male and a female of the same species and you'll soon have cute babies in the zoo.
You can only store a certain amount of admission money in the main building, so make sure to collect it regularly.
In order to make a profit from your buildings, they must always be connected by a path. How else would visitors be able to reach them?
Keep your eyes peeled: From time to time, special animals or items appear in the store that you can only purchase for a limited time.
Feed your animals superfood, they will stay full longer!
Oh! Your animals are sick? Give them super medicine and they'll be fit as a fiddle in no time!
